about: Where the DAQ cables each actuator: daq-server/config/profiles/default/config.toml [actuator_roles], name -> [channel, board_id]. The twin's suggested hookup puts a matched valve on the same connector. Which DAQ actuator board is the 12 V one and which the 24 V is not in the DAQ's config: board 12 is shown as Solenoids 12V and board 14 as Solenoids 24V until somebody says otherwise.
